title: Prepare crystal structure for wurtzite ZnO
action: Generate an input file for Quantum ESPRESSO describing the wurtzite ZnO unit cell with experimental lattice parameters a=3.244 Å, c=5.027 Å, and internal parameter u=0.380. Use a Γ‑centered k‑point grid equivalent to 10×10×10.
description: Create the structural input required for subsequent DFT calculations.

title: Self‑consistent LDA calculation
action: Run a self‑consistent field (SCF) calculation with Quantum ESPRESSO using the above structure, LDA exchange‑correlation, the chosen PAW pseudopotentials, and a 10×10×10 k‑mesh. Obtain the charge density and ground‑state wavefunctions.
description: The SCF step produces the Kohn‑Sham potential and wavefunctions needed for band structure and optics.

title: Non‑self‑consistent band‑structure and band‑gap determination
action: Perform a non‑self‑consistent (NSCF) calculation on a dense Γ‑centered k‑mesh (at least 20×20×20) to obtain Kohn‑Sham eigenvalues and wavefunctions along a path. Determine the direct band gap at the Γ point from the resulting eigenvalues.
description: This provides the band energies and wavefunctions on a fine k‑grid needed for the optical matrix elements, and the Γ‑point gap used for the scissor shift.

title: Compute dielectric function and optical spectra
action: Using the NSCF output, run the QE post‑processing tool (epsilon.x) to obtain the unbroadened imaginary dielectric function ε2(ω) from momentum matrix elements. Apply a rigid scissor shift to align the band gap to the experimental value of 3.4 eV, recalculating ε2 accordingly. Then perform Kramers‑Kronig transformation to obtain the real part ε1(ω), followed by computation of reflectivity R(ω)=|(√ε−1)/(√ε+1)|². Generate spectra.csv with columns 'energy' (eV), 'epsilon2' (dimensionless), 'reflectivity' (dimensionless) for photon energies from 0 to 20 eV in steps no larger than 0.1 eV.
description: The final optical spectra after scissor shift; the main quantitative result.
output_schema: CSV with header: energy,epsilon2,reflectivity. energy in eV (float), epsilon2 dimensionless (float), reflectivity dimensionless (float). 0–20 eV, step ≤0.1 eV.
